title: Desert Golf Course Water Use Map
description: Estimated daily irrigation water use for desert golf courses in California and Arizona, derived from ETo x Kc x irrigated acreage.

latest_water_use.title: Latest water use by course
latest_water_use.description: Each course's most recent daily water-use estimate. Renders as a map (datasette-cluster-map) via the latitude/longitude columns.

top_water_users.sql: SELECT name, state, date, gallons, acre_feet FROM latest_water_use ORDER BY gallons DESC
top_water_users.title: Courses ranked by latest estimated water use

course_history.sql: SELECT c.name, d.date, d.eto_inches, d.gallons, d.acre_feet FROM daily_water_use d JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = d.course_id WHERE c.name = :name ORDER BY d.date
course_history.title: Water use history for a course
